content:
Structure your Seedance prompt with clear sections (Generation Goal, References, Global Settings, Timestamp Script/Storyboard) to control long, complex ~20s sequences.

Use separate reference images for environment vs. characters, and explicitly state what each reference is for (e.g., “BACKGROUND/SPACE references ONLY”) to prevent the model from copying unwanted subjects.

Add explicit negative constraints for identity/feature control (e.g., “Do NOT output or reuse the people/creatures from background refs,” “NO TAIL,” “Do not interchange the soldiers’ and demon’s appearances, clothing, or positions”).

Lock character continuity by mapping each key character to a specific reference image (e.g., “Soldier A = @Image 3, Soldier B = @Image 4, Demon = @Image 5”) and describing required kit/details.

Specify concrete visual/render settings in the prompt (e.g., UE5/Lumen, 8K, ray-traced, film grain 12%, anamorphic lens, mild chromatic aberration, volumetric haze) to steer realism and lens look.

Define camera behavior explicitly (continuous dynamic hand-held, whip-pans, fast tracking, aerial follow; brief slow-mo only on hardest impacts) to guide motion and pacing.

Write a second-by-second storyboard with timestamps (e.g., 0–4s, 4–8s, 8–14s, 14–17s, 17–20s) and describe the exact action beats per segment to maintain narrative coherence across the clip.

Include “NOT” style exclusions (e.g., NOT anime, NOT painterly) to avoid drifting into unwanted aesthetics.

Add sensory/audio cue text (gunfire, impacts, screams, wing-beats) alongside each beat to reinforce intensity and timing of events.

[Thread 1] [Generation Goal]
Generate a photorealistic AAA game title-movie battle shot. WWI 1914, inside an abandoned gothic church, CONTINUING an already-raging demon-vs-soldiers battle. Central event: soldiers keep firing but the demon utterly ignores them, hurls one man into a wall, SEIZES another and flies acrobatically all over the nave, throws him into the others, and survivors flee to the door. Continuous, dynamic, hand-held combat energy. ~20s.

[References]
[Scenes / Texture]
@Image 1 and @Image 2 are BACKGROUND / SPACE references ONLY — use them for the church's spatial layout, architecture, scale, materials, dust, and lighting/atmosphere. Do NOT output or reuse the people/creatures shown in @Image 1 or @Image 2 directly.
[Characters]
Soldier A corresponds to @Image 3 (older, mustached German soldier). Soldier B corresponds to @Image 4 (young German soldier). Several more identical-kit soldiers fill the scene — all 1914 Imperial German army: pickelhaube spike helmets, feldgrau wool uniforms, leather gear, Gewehr98 rifles.
The demon Amon corresponds to @Image 5: long swept-back horns, glowing red eyes, large tattered bat-like wings, a lean muscular sinewy pitch-black body, long clawed limbs. NO TAIL — the demon must have ABSOLUTELY NO tail. About 3 meters tall (~twice a soldier's height); powerful and overwhelming, but NOT building-sized.
Do not interchange the soldiers' and demon's appearances, clothing, or positions.

[Global Settings]
Base environment & texture: WWI-1914 abandoned gothic cathedral interior at blood-red dusk; cold stone, thick floating dust and gunsmoke, toppled pews, drifting glass, volumetric haze; extreme realistic physical texture, film grain 12%, anamorphic lens, mild chromatic aberration.
Visual style: photorealistic live-action-grade CG, UE5/Lumen, 8K, ray-traced; cinematic depth of field; low-key lighting, deep crimson from the rose window, muzzle flashes strobing the dark.
NOT anime, NOT painterly.
Camera language: continuous DYNAMIC hand-held / swooping camera that follows the action — whip-pans, fast tracking, and an aerial follow as the demon flies. Real-time energetic combat, brief slow-mo only on the hardest impacts. Weighty, visceral, kinetic.
Core performance: the demon's contemptuous invulnerability, the brutal physicality of bodies hurled and thrown, terror and rout of the soldiers. Overwhelming, relentless.

[Timestamp Script Storyboard]
[0-4s] ① Battle continues — gunfire ignored
Action: mid-battle, several soldiers (incl. @Image 3, @Image 4) keep firing Gewehr98 rifles at the demon (@Image 5), muzzle flashes strobing; the demon UTTERLY IGNORES the gunfire — bullets spark harmlessly off its black hide as it stalks forward, unbothered. Hand-held, smoke and red haze.
Emotion Analysis: showing the demon walk through a hail of fire without a flinch establishes total futility — the men are already lost.
<ragged rifle volley, casings, bullets pinging off the demon, low demon growl>

[4-8s] ② A soldier is smashed into the wall
Action: the demon lashes out and HURLS a soldier who flies backward across the frame and SLAMS hard into a stone wall / pillar, crumpling to the floor; dust and debris burst. A terror scream rings out from another man. Whip-pan follows the body.
Emotion Analysis: the sickening wall impact and the scream turn the fight into slaughter — fear detonates.
<a body hurled, a heavy bone-crunching wall impact, a piercing terror scream, dust>

[8-14s] ③ Demon seizes a soldier and flies all over the nave
Action: the demon SEIZES one soldier in its clawed hand, beats its wings and LAUNCHES into the air, flying acrobatically and freely ALL OVER the nave — swooping between the great stone pillars, up toward the vaulted ceiling and back down — the camera dynamically follows the aerial rampage. The trapped man kicks and screams helplessly.
Emotion Analysis: the free, three-dimensional flight makes the demon feel like a predator that owns the whole space — nowhere is safe.
<powerful wing-beats and wind, the seized man's screams, rushing air, distant panicked shouts>

[14-17s] ④ Throws the man into the other soldiers
Action: at speed, the demon HURLS the grabbed soldier down into a cluster of the others like a projectile — bodies bowl over and scatter, rifles fly, dust erupts. Brutal, physical impact.
Emotion Analysis: using a man as a weapon against his comrades is the cruelty peak — dehumanizing.
<a whistling throw, a heavy multi-body collision, clattering rifles, cries>

Usa imágenes de referencia separadas para el entorno y para los personajes, y especifica explícitamente para qué sirve cada referencia (por ejemplo, “BACKGROUND/SPACE references ONLY”) para evitar que el modelo copie sujetos no deseados.

Añade restricciones negativas explícitas para el control de identidad/rasgos (por ejemplo, “Do NOT output or reuse the people/creatures from background refs,” “NO TAIL,” “Do not interchange the soldiers’ and demon’s appearances, clothing, or positions”).

Bloquea la continuidad de los personajes asignando a cada personaje clave una imagen de referencia específica (por ejemplo, “Soldier A = @Image 3, Soldier B = @Image 4, Demon = @Image 5”) y describiendo el equipo/detalles requeridos.

Especifica ajustes visuales/render concretos en el prompt (por ejemplo, UE5/Lumen, 8K, ray-traced, film grain 12%, anamorphic lens, mild chromatic aberration, volumetric haze) para orientar el realismo y el aspecto de la lente.

Define el comportamiento de cámara de forma explícita (continuous dynamic hand-held, whip-pans, fast tracking, aerial follow; brief slow-mo only on hardest impacts) para guiar el movimiento y el ritmo.

Escribe un storyboard segundo a segundo con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0–4s, 4–8s, 8–14s, 14–17s, 17–20s) y describe los beats de acción exactos por segmento para mantener la coherencia narrativa a lo largo del clip.

Incluye texto de señales sensoriales/de audio (gunfire, impacts, screams, wing-beats) junto a cada beat para reforzar la intensidad y el timing de los eventos.

Utilisez des images de référence séparées pour l’environnement et pour les personnages, et précisez explicitement à quoi sert chaque référence (par ex. « BACKGROUND/SPACE references ONLY ») afin d’empêcher le modèle de copier des sujets indésirables.

Ajoutez des contraintes négatives explicites pour le contrôle de l’identité et des caractéristiques (par ex. « Do NOT output or reuse the people/creatures from background refs », « NO TAIL », « Do not interchange the soldiers’ and demon’s appearances, clothing, or positions »).

Verrouillez la continuité des personnages en associant chaque personnage clé à une image de référence spécifique (par ex. « Soldier A = @Image 3, Soldier B = @Image 4, Demon = @Image 5 ») et en décrivant l’équipement et les détails requis.

Précisez dans le prompt des réglages visuels/rendu concrets (par ex. UE5/Lumen, 8K, ray-traced, film grain 12%, anamorphic lens, mild chromatic aberration, volumetric haze) pour orienter le réalisme et l’aspect optique.

Définissez explicitement le comportement de la caméra (continuous dynamic hand-held, whip-pans, fast tracking, aerial follow; brief slow-mo only on hardest impacts) pour guider le mouvement et le rythme.

Rédigez un storyboard seconde par seconde avec des timestamps (par ex. 0–4s, 4–8s, 8–14s, 14–17s, 17–20s) et décrivez les actions exactes de chaque segment afin de maintenir la cohérence narrative sur tout le clip.

Incluez des exclusions de type « NOT » (par ex. NOT anime, NOT painterly) pour éviter toute dérive vers des esthétiques indésirables.

Ajoutez du texte de repères sensoriels/audio (gunfire, impacts, screams, wing-beats) à côté de chaque beat afin de renforcer l’intensité et le timing des événements.

ko.content:
Seedance 프롬프트를 명확한 섹션(Generation Goal, References, Global Settings, Timestamp Script/Storyboard)으로 구조화해, 길고 복잡한 약 20초 시퀀스를 제어하세요.

환경과 캐릭터용 참조 이미지를 분리해서 사용하고, 각 참조가 무엇을 위한 것인지 명시적으로 적으세요(예: “BACKGROUND/SPACE references ONLY”). 그래야 모델이 원치 않는 피사체를 복사하는 것을 막을 수 있습니다.

정체성/특징 제어를 위해 명시적인 negative constraints를 추가하세요(예: “Do NOT output or reuse the people/creatures from background refs,” “NO TAIL,” “Do not interchange the soldiers’ and demon’s appearances, clothing, or positions”).

각 핵심 캐릭터를 특정 참조 이미지에 매핑해 캐릭터 연속성을 고정하세요(예: “Soldier A = @Image 3, Soldier B = @Image 4, Demon = @Image 5”) 그리고 필요한 장비/세부사항을 설명하세요.

프롬프트에 구체적인 시각/렌더 설정을 명시하세요(예: UE5/Lumen, 8K, ray-traced, film grain 12%, anamorphic lens, mild chromatic aberration, volumetric haze) — 사실감과 렌즈 느낌을 유도하기 위해서입니다.

카메라 동작을 명확하게 정의하세요(continuous dynamic hand-held, whip-pans, fast tracking, aerial follow; 가장 강한 충격에서만 brief slow-mo) — 움직임과 페이싱을 안내하기 위해서입니다.

타임스탬프가 포함된 초 단위 스토리보드를 작성하세요(예: 0–4s, 4–8s, 8–14s, 14–17s, 17–20s) 그리고 각 구간의 정확한 액션 비트를 설명해 클립 전체의 서사적 일관성을 유지하세요.

각 비트 옆에 감각/오디오 큐 텍스트(gunfire, impacts, screams, wing-beats)를 포함해 강도와 사건의 타이밍을 강화하세요.
